purpose: Stage A/C — offline ACTION contracts for Lucy context decisions. Separates desired ACTION shapes from known gaps. Not live-model proof. Stage C adds proofLevel labels and resolves A1/B1 pack tensions.

classification.pass_existing: Desired ACTION is clear and already covered by an offline suite (referenced in existingCoverage).
classification.gap_coverage: Desired ACTION is clear but lacked a dedicated offline ACTION contract — Stage A adds parse/contract asserts.
classification.gap_existing: Known tension or risk in current product/prompt/tests; documented, not locked as correct.
classification.desired_unclear: Desired product behavior not clear enough to assert; documented only.

proofLevels.parse_shape: Fixture metadata parses and assert helpers hold. Does NOT prove a model selected the ACTION.
proofLevels.engine_apply: Referenced offline engine/apply test (stub propose or pure engine) exercises execution. Still not live-model selection.
proofLevels.model_decision_contract: Pack/MODEL constraints document the desired decision; offline stub wire only — NOT live model competence.

stageCChangeLog: S-CLEAR-ASK → S-CLEAR-NOW (A1 unique shell remove NOW); added S-CLEAR-MULTI-SHELL-ASK.
DEL-CLEAR-ALL-UNIQUE-SHELL: gap_existing → pass_existing under A1; added DEL-CLEAR-MULTI-SHELL-ASK.
EVENT-HOST-DATE-COLLISION: desired_unclear → gap_coverage under B1 ASK; added EVENT-HOST-UNIQUE-DATE-CONTINUE + event-pack E-HOST-* cases.
Every case labeled proofLevel; gap_coverage must not be read as model-decision proof.
T-CLEAR-ASK → T-CLEAR-NOW (A1 unique tasks shell remove NOW); added T-CLEAR-MULTI-SHELL-ASK — post–Stage C residual closed offline.

clusters.line_number_mutate: Prompt + engine guard; Stage A adds ACTION fixture.
